meta.name: content-repurposer
meta.description: Repurpose one piece of affiliate content into multiple formats. Triggers on: "repurpose my content", "turn my blog into tweets", "cross-post this", "content recycling", "convert to newsletter", "make a tweet thread from this", "adapt for TikTok", "omnichannel content", "scale my content", "turn this into a LinkedIn post", "repurpose for email", "content multiplication".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将一篇联盟内容自动改写为多种格式，适配不同平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速将一篇内容改头换面发布到不同渠道
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly adapt a single piece of content for various channels

howto.what: 当你提供一份内容（如博客、视频脚本），Claude 会将其自动改写成适合多个平台的版本，如推文串、LinkedIn 帖子、电子邮件等，每个版本都符合对应平台的规则和合规要求。
howto.when: 当你说出“repurpose my content”、“turn my blog into tweets”等关键词，或要求把已有内容分发到更多平台时触发。

say.text: 把我的博客改写成推文串和LinkedIn帖子
say.note: Claude 会生成两套独立内容，附带发布建议。

say.text: 把这段视频脚本转成TikTok脚本和newsletter
say.note: Claude 会按平台要求调整长度和风格。

say.text: 把现有博客内容扩展到Reddit和邮件
say.note: Claude 会为每个平台提供适配版本及链接放置规则。

howto.what_en: When you provide a piece of content (e.g., blog, video script), Claude automatically repurposes it into multiple platform-specific formats like tweet threads, LinkedIn posts, emails, etc., each adapted to platform rules and compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "repurpose my content", "turn my blog into tweets", or ask to distribute existing content across more platforms.

say_en.text: Turn my blog into a tweet thread and LinkedIn post
say_en.note: Claude generates two separate content blocks with posting tips.

say_en.text: Convert this video script into a TikTok script and newsletter
say_en.note: Claude adjusts length and tone for each platform.

say_en.text: Repurpose my existing blog for Reddit and email
say_en.note: Claude creates platform-adapted versions with link placement rules.
